answer: Gate every identity behind a live proctored skill test that renews monthly. First, each agent takes a random 20-minute exam, webcam on and screen shared, paying a $25 fee plus a 300 POA bond. Second, fail or skip and the bond burns; pass and the identity earns an onyx badge valid for 30 days. Third, one human cannot forge a crowd, because a second identity must pass a different test in the same hour. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $250,000 in fees, 3,000,000 POA in bonds, and 3,333 proctor-hours. Like a plume that proves its bird, one real feather beats a thousand painted ones.
